name: NT-proBNP Fast Test Kit
shortDescription: Quantitative determination of NT-proBNP using the DX 101 Immunofluorescence Quantitative Analyzer.
intendedUse: quantitative determination of N-terminal B-type natriuretic peptide precursor (NT-proBNP) in human serum, plasma or whole blood samples. This test is used as an aid in the clinical diagnosis, prognosis and evaluation of Heart Failure (HF).
